## logit 

```{r}
library(limma)

theta <- fit_multinom$L                 # N x K (cells x topics)
stopifnot(nrow(theta) == nrow(meta_balanced))

# logit transform (topic vs rest)
eps <- 1e-6
theta_safe <- pmin(pmax(theta, eps), 1 - eps)
Z <- log(theta_safe / (1 - theta_safe)) # N x K

# limma wants features x samples => K x N
Y <- t(Z)
rownames(Y) <- paste0("T", seq_len(ncol(theta)))   # topic names

```
```{r}
df <- droplevels(meta_balanced)
df$treatment  <- droplevels(factor(df$treatment))
df$dosage     <- droplevels(factor(df$dosage))
df$time       <- droplevels(factor(df$time))
df$cell_state <- droplevels(factor(df$cell_state, levels=c("G1","S","G2","M","APOP")))

# combined condition factor
df$cond <- interaction(df$treatment, df$dosage, df$time, sep = "_", drop = TRUE)

# set baseline level as reference (make sure the string matches your levels)
levels(df$cond)  # inspect once
df$cond <- relevel(df$cond, ref = "WT_0_0")

# design: each condition vs baseline, adjusting for cell_state (optional)
design <- model.matrix(~ cond + cell_state, data = df)
colnames(design) <- make.names(colnames(design))

limma::is.fullrank(design)
fit <- eBayes(lmFit(Y, design), robust = TRUE)

```

```{r}
cond_coefs <- grep("^cond", colnames(design), value = TRUE)

res_cond_all <- do.call(rbind, lapply(cond_coefs, function(cf) {
  tt <- topTable(fit, coef = cf, number = Inf, sort.by = "P")
  tt$coef <- cf
  tt$topic <- rownames(tt)
  tt
}))

res_cond_all
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(circlize)

# res_cond_all: rows = topic x condition coefficients
# required columns: topic, coef, logFC, adj.P.Val

dir_df <- res_cond_all %>%
  mutate(
    code = ifelse(adj.P.Val < 0.05, sign(logFC), 0),
    coef = gsub("^cond", "", coef)  # optional: shorten names
  ) %>%
  select(topic, coef, code) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = coef, values_from = code, values_fill = 0)

dir_m <- as.matrix(dir_df[, -1])
rownames(dir_m) <- dir_df$topic

Heatmap(
  dir_m,
  name = "Dir (FDR<0.05)",
  col = c("-1" = "blue", "0" = "white", "1" = "red"),
  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  cluster_columns = TRUE
)

```

```{r}
score_df <- res_cond_all %>%
  mutate(
    score = -log10(adj.P.Val + 1e-300) * sign(logFC),
    coef = gsub("^cond", "", coef)
  ) %>%
  select(topic, coef, score) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = coef, values_from = score, values_fill = 0)

score_m <- as.matrix(score_df[, -1])
rownames(score_m) <- score_df$topic

rng <- quantile(abs(score_m), 0.98, na.rm = TRUE)

Heatmap(
  score_m,
  name = "signed -log10(FDR)",
  col = colorRamp2(c(-rng, 0, rng), c("blue", "white", "red")),
  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  cluster_columns = FALSE
)
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(circlize)
library(grid)

alpha <- 0.05

score_df <- res_cond_all %>%
  mutate(
    score = -log10(adj.P.Val + 1e-300) * sign(logFC),
    sig   = adj.P.Val < alpha,
    coef  = gsub("^cond", "", coef)
  ) %>%
  select(topic, coef, score, sig) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = coef,
              values_from = c(score, sig),
              values_fill = list(score = 0, sig = FALSE))
# score matrix
score_m <- as.matrix(score_df %>% select(starts_with("score_")))
rownames(score_m) <- score_df$topic
colnames(score_m) <- sub("^score_", "", colnames(score_m))

# significance matrix (logical)
sig_m <- as.matrix(score_df %>% select(starts_with("sig_")))
rownames(sig_m) <- score_df$topic
colnames(sig_m) <- sub("^sig_", "", colnames(sig_m))
rng <- quantile(abs(score_m), 0.98, na.rm = TRUE)

col_fun <- colorRamp2(
  c(-rng, 0, rng),
  c("blue", "white", "red")
)
Heatmap(
  score_m,
  name = "sign(logFC)\n× -log10(BH)",
  col = col_fun,
  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  cluster_columns = FALSE,

  cell_fun = function(j, i, x, y, w, h, fill) {
    if (sig_m[i, j]) {
      grid.rect(
        x = x, y = y,
        width = w, height = h,
        gp = gpar(col = "black", fill = NA, lwd = 1.2)
      )
    }
  }
)

```

```{r}
Heatmap(
  fc_m,
  name = "logFC",

  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  cluster_columns = FALSE,

    if (sig_m[i, j]) {
      grid.rect(
        x = x, y = y,
        width = w, height = h,
        gp = gpar(col = "black", fill = NA, lwd = 1.2)
      )
    }
  }
)
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)

alpha <- 0.05
topics_per_plot <- 6

plot_df <- res_cond_all %>%
  mutate(coef = gsub("^cond", "", coef)) %>%
  separate(coef, into = c("treatment","dosage","time"), sep = "_", convert = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(
    sig = adj.P.Val < alpha,
    dosage = factor(dosage),
    time = as.numeric(time)
  )

# order topics by "most significant anywhere" (so plot1 shows strongest)
topic_order <- plot_df %>%
  group_by(topic) %>%
  summarise(minFDR = min(adj.P.Val, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  arrange(minFDR) %>%
  pull(topic)

plot_df <- plot_df %>%
  mutate(topic = factor(topic, levels = topic_order))

# assign each topic to a panel group: 1..3
topic_groups <- tibble(topic = topic_order) %>%
  mutate(group_id = ceiling(row_number() / topics_per_plot))

plot_df2 <- plot_df %>%
  left_join(topic_groups, by = "topic")

make_plot <- function(gid) {
  ggplot(filter(plot_df2, group_id == gid),
         aes(x = time, y = logFC,
             group = interaction(treatment, dosage),
             color = treatment, linetype = dosage)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
    geom_point(aes(shape = sig), size = 2) +
    scale_shape_manual(values = c(`FALSE` = 1, `TRUE` = 16)) +
    facet_wrap(~ topic, scales = "free_y") +
    scale_x_log10() +
    labs(x = "Time", y = "logFC vs WT_0_0", shape = "BH < 0.05",
         title = paste0("Topics ", (gid-1)*topics_per_plot + 1, "–", min(gid*topics_per_plot, length(topic_order)))) +
    theme_bw()
}

p1 <- make_plot(1)
p2 <- make_plot(2)
p3 <- make_plot(3)

p1
p2
p3
```

```{r}
make_plot <- function(gid) {
  ggplot(filter(plot_df2, group_id == gid),
         aes(x = time, y = logFC,
             group = interaction(treatment, dosage),
             color = treatment, linetype = dosage)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +

    scale_x_log10() +
    labs(x = "Time", y = "logFC vs WT_0_0", shape = "BH < 0.05",
         title = paste0("Topics ", (gid-1)*topics_per_plot + 1, "–",
                        min(gid*topics_per_plot, length(topic_order)))) +
    theme_bw()
}

p1 <- make_plot(1)  # T1–T6
p2 <- make_plot(2)  # T7–T12
p3 <- make_plot(3)  # T13–T16

p1
```

## treatment*dosage*time*cell_state
```{r}
df <- droplevels(meta_balanced)

df$treatment  <- droplevels(factor(df$treatment))
df$dosage     <- droplevels(factor(df$dosage))
df$time       <- droplevels(factor(df$time))
df$cell_state <- droplevels(factor(df$cell_state, levels=c("G1","S","G2","M","APOP")))

# ✅ condition now includes cell_state
df$cond_cs <- interaction(df$treatment, df$dosage, df$time, df$cell_state,
                          sep = "_", drop = TRUE)

# inspect to confirm the exact string exists
levels(df$cond_cs)

# ✅ set baseline reference
df$cond_cs <- relevel(df$cond_cs, ref = "WT_0_0_G1")

# ✅ design: only this combined condition
design_cs <- model.matrix(~ cond_cs, data = df)
colnames(design_cs) <- make.names(colnames(design_cs))

stopifnot(limma::is.fullrank(design_cs))

fit_cs <- eBayes(lmFit(Y, design_cs), robust = TRUE)

```

```{r}
cond_cs_coefs <- grep("^cond_cs", colnames(design_cs), value = TRUE)

res_cond_cs_all <- do.call(rbind, lapply(cond_cs_coefs, function(cf) {
  tt <- topTable(fit_cs, coef = cf, number = Inf, sort.by = "P")
  tt$coef <- cf
  tt$topic <- rownames(tt)
  tt
}))

res_cond_cs_all

```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(circlize)
library(grid)

alpha <- 0.05

p_df <- res_cond_cs_all %>%
  mutate(
    coef = gsub("^cond_cs", "", coef),          # drop prefix if present
    neglogFDR = -log10(adj.P.Val + 1e-300),
    sig = adj.P.Val < alpha
  ) %>%
  select(topic, coef, neglogFDR, sig) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = coef,
    values_from = c(neglogFDR, sig),
    values_fill = list(neglogFDR = 0, sig = FALSE)
  )

# matrix of -log10(FDR)
p_m <- as.matrix(p_df %>% select(starts_with("neglogFDR_")))
rownames(p_m) <- p_df$topic
colnames(p_m) <- sub("^neglogFDR_", "", colnames(p_m))

# significance matrix
sig_m <- as.matrix(p_df %>% select(starts_with("sig_")))
rownames(sig_m) <- p_df$topic
colnames(sig_m) <- sub("^sig_", "", colnames(sig_m))

cap <- quantile(p_m, 0.98, na.rm = TRUE)
col_fun <- colorRamp2(c(0, cap/4, cap/2, cap),
                      c("white", "#deebf7", "#9ecae1", "#08519c"))

Heatmap(
  p_m,
  name = "-log10(FDR)",
  col = col_fun,
  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  cluster_columns = FALSE,
  show_column_names = FALSE,   # usually too many conditions; turn on if you want
  cell_fun = function(j, i, x, y, w, h, fill) {
    if (sig_m[i, j]) {
      grid.rect(x, y, w, h, gp = gpar(col = "black", fill = NA, lwd = 1.2))
    }
  }
)

```
```{r}
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(grid)

plot_heatmap_chunks <- function(p_m, sig_m, col_fun, cols_per_plot = 40) {
  cn <- colnames(p_m)
  n  <- length(cn)
  nchunks <- ceiling(n / cols_per_plot)

  ht_list <- vector("list", nchunks)

  for (k in seq_len(nchunks)) {
    j1 <- (k - 1) * cols_per_plot + 1
    j2 <- min(k * cols_per_plot, n)
    cols <- cn[j1:j2]

    ht_list[[k]] <- Heatmap(
      p_m[, cols, drop = FALSE],
      name = "-log10(FDR)",
      col = col_fun,
      cluster_rows = TRUE,
      cluster_columns = FALSE,
      show_column_names = TRUE,
      column_names_rot = 45,
      column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 7),
      cell_fun = function(j, i, x, y, w, h, fill) {
        if (sig_m[i, cols[j]]) {
          grid.rect(x, y, w, h, gp = gpar(col = "black", fill = NA, lwd = 1.1))
        }
      },
      column_title = paste0("Conditions ", j1, "–", j2)
    )
  }

  # draw sequentially (each appears one after another)
  for (k in seq_along(ht_list)) draw(ht_list[[k]])
  invisible(ht_list)
}

plot_heatmap_chunks(p_m, sig_m, col_fun, cols_per_plot = 35)

```

```{r}
library(tidyr)
library(dplyr)

col_info <- tibble(coef = colnames(p_m)) %>%
  separate(coef, into = c("treatment","dosage","time","cell_state"),
           sep = "_", remove = FALSE, fill = "right")

# (optional) nicer ordering
col_info <- col_info %>%
  mutate(
    dosage = as.numeric(dosage),
    time   = as.numeric(time),
    cell_state = factor(cell_state, levels = c("G1","S","G2","M","APOP"))
  ) %>%
  arrange(cell_state, time, dosage, treatment)

col_order <- col_info$coef
library(RColorBrewer)

ha <- HeatmapAnnotation(
  df = col_info %>% select(treatment, dosage, time, cell_state),
  col = list(
    treatment  = setNames(brewer.pal(max(3, n_distinct(col_info$treatment)), "Set2"),
                          unique(col_info$treatment)),
    cell_state = setNames(brewer.pal(max(3, nlevels(col_info$cell_state)), "Dark2"),
                          levels(col_info$cell_state))
  ),
  show_annotation_name = TRUE,
  annotation_name_gp = gpar(fontsize = 8)
)

draw(Heatmap(
  p_m[, col_order, drop = FALSE],
  name = "-log10(FDR)",
  col = col_fun,
  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  cluster_columns = FALSE,
  top_annotation = ha,
  show_column_names = FALSE,   # now annotation carries meaning
  cell_fun = function(j, i, x, y, w, h, fill) {
    if (sig_m[i, col_order[j]]) {
      grid.rect(x, y, w, h, gp = gpar(col = "black", fill = NA, lwd = 1.1))
    }
  }
))
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(circlize)
library(grid)
library(RColorBrewer)

alpha <- 0.05

# ---- build wide matrices: logFC + significance ----
df_wide <- res_cond_cs_all %>%
  mutate(
    coef = gsub("^cond_cs", "", coef),
    sig  = adj.P.Val < alpha
  ) %>%
  select(topic, coef, logFC, sig) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = coef,
    values_from = c(logFC, sig),
    values_fill = list(logFC = 0, sig = FALSE)
  )

# logFC matrix
logfc_m <- as.matrix(df_wide %>% select(starts_with("logFC_")))
rownames(logfc_m) <- df_wide$topic
colnames(logfc_m) <- sub("^logFC_", "", colnames(logfc_m))

# significance matrix
sig_m <- as.matrix(df_wide %>% select(starts_with("sig_")))
rownames(sig_m) <- df_wide$topic
colnames(sig_m) <- sub("^sig_", "", colnames(sig_m))

# ---- parse and order columns (same idea as you had) ----
col_info <- tibble(coef = colnames(logfc_m)) %>%
  separate(coef, into = c("treatment","dosage","time","cell_state"),
           sep = "_", remove = FALSE, fill = "right") %>%
  mutate(
    dosage = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(dosage)),
    time   = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(time)),
    cell_state = factor(cell_state, levels = c("G1","S","G2","M","APOP"))
  ) %>%
  arrange(cell_state, time, dosage, treatment)

col_order <- col_info$coef

# ---- top annotation ----
ha <- HeatmapAnnotation(
  df = col_info %>% select(treatment, dosage, time, cell_state),
  col = list(
    treatment  = setNames(brewer.pal(max(3, n_distinct(col_info$treatment)), "Set2"),
                          sort(unique(col_info$treatment))),
    cell_state = setNames(brewer.pal(max(3, nlevels(col_info$cell_state)), "Dark2"),
                          levels(col_info$cell_state))
  ),
  show_annotation_name = TRUE,
  annotation_name_gp = gpar(fontsize = 8)
)

# ---- color function for logFC (robust cap) ----
cap <- quantile(abs(logfc_m), 0.98, na.rm = TRUE)
col_fun_fc <- colorRamp2(c(-cap, 0, cap), c("#2166AC", "white", "#B2182B"))

draw(Heatmap(
  logfc_m[, col_order, drop = FALSE],
  name = "logFC",
  col = col_fun_fc,
  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  cluster_columns = FALSE,
  top_annotation = ha,
  show_column_names = FALSE,
  cell_fun = function(j, i, x, y, w, h, fill) {
    if (sig_m[i, col_order[j]]) {
      grid.rect(x, y, w, h, gp = gpar(col = "black", fill = NA, lwd = 1.1))
    }
  }
))
```

## add spline effect wtih no cell state (treatment * dosage * ns(log(time),3)
```{r}
library(limma)
library(splines)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)

df <- droplevels(meta_balanced)

# treated-only
idx <- which(df$treatment != "WT")
df2 <- droplevels(df[idx, ])
Y2  <- Y[, idx, drop = FALSE]

# factors
df2$treatment <- droplevels(factor(df2$treatment))
df2$dosage    <- droplevels(factor(df2$dosage))

# numeric time (minutes) + log time
df2$time_min <- as.numeric(as.character(df2$time))
df2$time_num <- log(df2$time_min)

# spline basis
ns_obj <- ns(df2$time_num, df = 3)
B <- ns_obj
colnames(B) <- paste0("B", 1:ncol(B))
df2 <- cbind(df2, B)

# --- NO cell_state here ---
design2 <- model.matrix(~ treatment * dosage * (B1 + B2 + B3), data = df2)
colnames(design2) <- make.names(colnames(design2))
stopifnot(limma::is.fullrank(design2))

fit2 <- eBayes(lmFit(Y2, design2), robust = TRUE)

```


```{r}
library(limma)
library(splines)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)

# --- response Y already built from theta via logit, as in your code ---

df <- droplevels(meta_balanced)

# treated-only (because WT exists only at baseline)
idx <- which(df$treatment != "WT")
df2 <- droplevels(df[idx, ])
Y2  <- Y[, idx, drop = FALSE]   # K x Ntreated

# factors
df2$treatment  <- droplevels(factor(df2$treatment))      # reference = first level (often Gefitinib)
df2$dosage     <- droplevels(factor(df2$dosage))         # reference = lowest dose
df2$cell_state <- droplevels(factor(df2$cell_state, levels=c("G1","S","G2","M","APOP")))

# numeric time (minutes) + log time
df2$time_min <- as.numeric(as.character(df2$time))
df2$time_num <- log(df2$time_min)

# create spline basis with stable column names
ns_obj <- ns(df2$time_num, df = 3)
B <- ns_obj
colnames(B) <- paste0("B", 1:ncol(B))   # B1,B2,B3
df2 <- cbind(df2, B)

# spline model: treatment * dosage * spline(time) + cell_state
design2 <- model.matrix(~ treatment * dosage * (B1 + B2 + B3) + cell_state, data = df2)
colnames(design2) <- make.names(colnames(design2))
```

## add spline effect with cell state(additive effect) (treatment * dosage * (B1 + B2 + B3) + cell_state)
```{r}
library(limma)
library(splines)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)

# --- response Y already built from theta via logit, as in your code ---

df <- droplevels(meta_balanced)

# treated-only (because WT exists only at baseline)
idx <- which(df$treatment != "WT")
df2 <- droplevels(df[idx, ])
Y2  <- Y[, idx, drop = FALSE]   # K x Ntreated

# factors
df2$treatment  <- droplevels(factor(df2$treatment))      # reference = first level (often Gefitinib)
df2$dosage     <- droplevels(factor(df2$dosage))         # reference = lowest dose
df2$cell_state <- droplevels(factor(df2$cell_state, levels=c("G1","S","G2","M","APOP")))

# numeric time (minutes) + log time
df2$time_min <- as.numeric(as.character(df2$time))
df2$time_num <- log(df2$time_min)

# create spline basis with stable column names
ns_obj <- ns(df2$time_num, df = 3)
B <- ns_obj
colnames(B) <- paste0("B", 1:ncol(B))   # B1,B2,B3
df2 <- cbind(df2, B)

# spline model: treatment * dosage * spline(time) + cell_state
design2 <- model.matrix(~ treatment * dosage * (B1 + B2 + B3) + cell_state, data = df2)
colnames(design2) <- make.names(colnames(design2))

stopifnot(limma::is.fullrank(design2))

fit2 <- eBayes(lmFit(Y2, design2), robust = TRUE)
```




```{r}
# smooth time trend in the reference group (ref treatment & ref dosage)
cols_time_main <- grep("^B[0-9]+$", colnames(design2))
topTable(fit2, coef = cols_time_main, number = Inf)

# does the time curve differ by treatment?  (treatment × spline)
cols_trt_time <- grep("^treatment.*\\.B[0-9]+$", colnames(design2))
topTable(fit2, coef = cols_trt_time, number = Inf)

# does the time curve differ by dosage? (dosage × spline)
cols_dose_time <- grep("^dosage.*\\.B[0-9]+$", colnames(design2))
topTable(fit2, coef = cols_dose_time, number = Inf)
```

## * cell state (treatment * dosage * ns(t,3) * cell_state)
```{r}
library(limma)
library(splines)

df <- droplevels(meta_balanced)

# treated-only (WT only at baseline)
idx <- which(df$treatment != "WT")
df2 <- droplevels(df[idx, ])
Y2  <- Y[, idx, drop = FALSE]   # K x Ntreated

# factors (pick consistent reference levels if you want)
df2$treatment  <- droplevels(factor(df2$treatment))
df2$dosage     <- droplevels(factor(df2$dosage))
df2$cell_state <- droplevels(factor(df2$cell_state, levels=c("G1","S","G2","M","APOP")))

# time (minutes) -> log time
df2$time_min <- as.numeric(as.character(df2$time))
df2$time_num <- log(df2$time_min)

# spline basis with fixed names
ns_obj <- ns(df2$time_num, df = 3)
B <- ns_obj
colnames(B) <- paste0("B", 1:ncol(B))   # B1,B2,B3
df2 <- cbind(df2, B)

# ✅ fully interacted model
design2 <- model.matrix(~ treatment * dosage * (B1 + B2 + B3) * cell_state, data = df2)
colnames(design2) <- make.names(colnames(design2))

# check full rank (may fail if some combos are missing)
stopifnot(limma::is.fullrank(design2))

fit2 <- eBayes(lmFit(Y2, design2), robust = TRUE)

```

```{r}
cols_time_main
tt_time_main <- topTable(fit2, coef = cols_time_main, number = Inf, sort.by = "F")
(tt_time_main[, c("F","P.Value","adj.P.Val")])
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

# grid over time (log-spaced)
t_grid_min <- exp(seq(log(min(df2$time_min)), log(max(df2$time_min)), length.out = 200))
t_grid_num <- log(t_grid_min)

# spline basis on grid using SAME knots/boundary from ns_obj
B_grid <- predict(ns_obj, newx = t_grid_num)
colnames(B_grid) <- paste0("B", 1:ncol(B_grid))  # B1..B3

# expand grid over treatment x dosage x cell_state x time
newdat <- expand.grid(
  treatment  = levels(df2$treatment),
  dosage     = levels(df2$dosage),
  cell_state = levels(df2$cell_state),
  time_min   = t_grid_min
)
newdat$time_num <- log(newdat$time_min)

# attach B1..B3 (match via time_num)
newdat <- cbind(newdat, B_grid[match(newdat$time_num, t_grid_num), , drop = FALSE])

# enforce factor levels (prevents contrasts errors)
newdat$treatment  <- factor(newdat$treatment,  levels = levels(df2$treatment))
newdat$dosage     <- factor(newdat$dosage,     levels = levels(df2$dosage))
newdat$cell_state <- factor(newdat$cell_state, levels = levels(df2$cell_state))

# build design for new data (same formula as fit)
Xnew <- model.matrix(~ treatment * dosage * (B1 + B2 + B3) * cell_state, data = newdat)
colnames(Xnew) <- make.names(colnames(Xnew))

# align coefficient columns (in case of ordering differences)
common_cols <- intersect(colnames(Xnew), colnames(fit2$coefficients))
Xnew_use <- Xnew[, common_cols, drop = FALSE]

topics_to_plot <- rownames(fit2$coefficients)  # e.g. T1..T16

pred_df <- bind_rows(lapply(topics_to_plot, function(tp) {
  b <- fit2$coefficients[tp, common_cols]
  out <- newdat
  out$topic <- tp
  out$pred_logit <- as.numeric(Xnew_use %*% b)
  out$pred_theta <- plogis(out$pred_logit)   # ✅ proportion
  out
}))

```



```{r}
pred_df <- pred_df %>% mutate(topic = factor(topic, levels = paste0("T", 1:16)))

plot_block <- function(tops, title_suffix="") {
  ggplot(filter(pred_df, topic %in% tops),
         aes(x = time_min, y = pred_theta,
             color = treatment, linetype = dosage,
             group = interaction(treatment, dosage))) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
    scale_x_log10() +
    facet_grid(cell_state ~ topic, scales = "free_y") +
    theme_bw() +
    labs(x="Time (log scale)",
         y="Predicted topic proportion",
         title=paste0("Spline trajectories (proportion) ", title_suffix))
}

p1 <- plot_block(paste0("T", 1:6),  "(T1–T6)")
p2 <- plot_block(paste0("T", 7:12), "(T7–T12)")
p3 <- plot_block(paste0("T", 13:16),"(T13–T16)")

p1; p2; p3

```
